Method.name: OnInit
Method.Description: This user callback method is called just after %OnNew()

Method.name: OnTask
Method.Description: default InboundAdapter behavior: always call ProcessInput on CallInterval

Method.name: SendMessageToService
Method.Implementation:
#dim tSC As %Status Set tSc = $$$OK
set strData=##class(%Stream.GlobalCharacter).%New()
$$$LOGINFO("SendMessageToService: Write to stream") set wStat = strData.Write(comMsg) $$$LOGINFO("stream write: " _ comMsg _ ", stat: " _ wStat)
Set tStream=$classmethod(..#CONTAINERCLASS,"%New",strData) $$$LOGINFO("SendMessageToService: Call ProcessInput") Set tSC=..BusinessHost.ProcessInput(tStream) Quit:$$$ISERR(tSC) $$$LOGINFO("SendMessageToService: ProcessInput " _ tSc) Return tSC

Method.name: OnTearDown
Method.Description: This user callback method is called just before %OnClose()
